name: Prove done on a real run and read back the side effect
summary: Before reporting done, run on a real input and read the target system back (file, sent folder, ticket, page); record CLAIM / SIDE-EFFECT / DIFF; never trust 'sent'/'fixed' summaries; open the artifact a second time against last-known-good; prompt wording like 'make no mistakes' is not a control.
evidence: shown (ClickUp post missing, emails 25% sent) + said
jarvis_use: done requires an evidence field from an automatic read-back of the side effect.

name: Independent verifier session (no self-PASS)
summary: A separate read-only session or model grades the work against last-known-good, with no builder plan; the builder never fills GRADE; QA bounces failures back to the builders; stuck fix loops escalate to the human. Covers the intent-verification and compounding-misalignment cautions.
jarvis_use: A verify step routed by Jev to a different provider grades before done; escalate after 2 failed rounds.

name: Cross-model referee and blind third-party bakeoff
summary: A third model writes the task and judges anonymized outputs (pass counts, scores, deciding edge case); variants are blind-then-reveal judging and multi-round cross-model plan critique.

name: Hidden hold-outs written before the build
summary: The verifier writes acceptance scenarios with pass/fail conditions before building, stored where the builder cannot read them; graded after the build with a leak check.

name: GRADE record template
summary: Fixed fields BUILDER/VERIFIER/HYPOTHESIS/LABELED/MISS/GRADE, a per-hold-out result table, observation gaps kept separate from product misses, and pending stubs that name the blocker.

name: Per-step verify card (ACT/EXPECTED/OBSERVED/COMPARE/NEXT)
summary: After each browser or screen action, record expected vs observed state from a snapshot, compare, then decide next; retry at most twice, then escalate; capture the screen the moment a live check diverges.
jarvis_use: The computer and safari tools already re-snapshot; add EXPECTED/COMPARE fields to the trace.

name: Honest not-run / UNKNOWN reporting
summary: Never write OBSERVED for steps that did not run (tab dropped); report measured times, not agent estimates; say 'I don't know' and come back tested; write a coverage-gap card instead of inventing a procedure.

name: Written done-check and hard cap before any loop
summary: State a countable or metric stop ('N rows, these columns, then stop', 'metric = target'), how it is checked, and a hard cap; refuse 'until satisfied'; when the cap is hit with the metric unmet, halt and report. Variants: trigger/action/stop scope, human-readable success criteria, sandwich delegation, outcome-criteria self-evaluation, objective metric for auto-research loops, verification along the way.
jarvis_use: The repetition brake exists; add a required done-check and cap to each job.

name: Scope-drop detection gate
summary: List every requirement in the original ask, diff the plan against it, and block execution if any ask has no plan item.

name: KPI and baseline scoping gate before building
summary: Fill bucket/KPI/baseline/60-day target before any build; don't build without an SOP and KPI; scope the smallest valuable product with an explicit not-building list.

name: Before/after proof capture
summary: Record the baseline before shipping, re-measure at 30/60/90 days or after a fixed hands-off window, report raw counts and one verifiable before-to-after sentence.

name: Capped small-batch first run
summary: Run a bulk job on a small sample (for example 10 leads, 200 of 622 listings), inspect every output field, then scale.

name: Fixture capture and replay with side effects cut
summary: Pin a real captured input (or self-sent samples, or a realistic fictional record), disconnect side-effecting branches, and replay while debugging downstream steps or failure branches.

name: Time-triggered job testing
summary: Test date filters with a shifted clock, fire scheduled tasks on demand in prod and check the destination, and rehearse timed events with lead time and a seconds-accurate clock.

name: Supervised runs before unattended (trust ladder)
summary: Watch and correct the first runs, run-now loops until a clean one-shot, at least 10 watched runs for money-adjacent skills, reduce supervision gradually, and keep an inventory of running automations.

name: Test-observe-fix loop with written defect notes
summary: After each live test, write concrete likes/dislikes and defects, revise per batch, and retest; the prompt is living; ship a fail-fast prototype, cluster edge cases into guardrails, and tune category descriptions from misroutes.

name: Localize the failing layer
summary: For wrong output, check in order: the raw tool response, the args/payload sent (time zone, missing fields, static prompt with no variable, empty sub-agent message, key names with spaces), the model/credential wiring, then the agent's interpretation; trace a null field back to the first upstream step that lost it.

name: Context failure-mode diagnosis
summary: Label wrong answers as poisoning, bloat, confusion or clash; check the fact exists in memory before redesigning retrieval; separate model problems from prompt/skill problems.

name: Structured per-job trace and error log
summary: Log every run, success or error: input, tool calls, args, tokens, step durations, outcome, model, memory writes with their source; a central error log; a per-step timeline; read each step's input/config/output after a green run; structured end-of-session record.
jarvis_use: The cost meter and procedural memory exist; add a JSONL trace per tool call that includes failures.

name: Provider-side logs and 5xx triage
summary: Read the vendor dashboard logs (prompts sent, durations, retries); treat a 5xx as possibly a vendor outage or silent content reject rather than your own bug.

name: Audit delegation briefs
summary: Open each sub-agent's received prompt and confirm the goal, recipients and outputs match the request.

name: Golden labeled set, rerun on every change
summary: Keep inputs with expected outputs per task/classifier, score per row (correctness, tokens, latency), and rerun on every model, prompt or skill change, including when porting to a new model; use varied inputs and one fixed set across time.
jarvis_use: Backs Jev routing decisions with per-class golden sets.

name: One-knob, hypothesis-first A/B
summary: Write the hypothesis and expected outputs, then change exactly one variable (model, prompt, tool, skill) while holding inputs constant. Variants: duplicate repo with and without CLAUDE.md/skills, no-skill control run, capability toggle off/on, worker-tier A/B, removing an extra prompt hop.

name: Eval statistics hygiene
summary: Small sets are not decisive (enlarge before choosing); add a cost column; count refusals separately; report median and mean latency; project the error rate to real volume; plant a known-hard item; label fail types separately; stamp the model and date on each run and expect non-determinism; flag an incumbent inside a router as a confound.

name: Calibrate the grader before it gates
summary: Give subjective scoring to a separate scorer and validate it against labeled examples before trusting its decisions.

name: Model bakeoff on Evens's own tasks
summary: Run the same prompt or task across models or retrieval stores inside the real harness and decide per use case; treat vendor benchmarks with salt and drop discredited ones; open creative probes are taste only.

name: Full tool round-trip test before routing to a model
summary: Before adopting a brain model or provider path, run a harmless multi-hop tool call; check that provider-required fields (for example Gemini thought signatures) survive the loop; bisect the tool set when tool calling fails; watch behavior changes when porting.
jarvis_use: Jev pools span 6 providers; a broken tool loop on one stalls jobs on escalation.

name: Log the responding model id (silent downgrade)
summary: Read the model field on every API response and flag a mismatch with the requested model; confirm run labels match the model actually used.

name: Evaluating a new tool
summary: State each product's audience and fixed comparison categories before scoring; test from a blank canvas, not templates; probe a generator with vague, specific and agentic prompts and record what each tier left broken.

name: Cite with locator and verify quoted spans
summary: Force document/page/section plus an exact quote; search the source for the span (zero hits = invalid); inspect grounding metadata; confirm a retrieval call fired before each answer; attach URLs and a date to live facts; return links for fetched items.

name: Verify every number, label UNVERIFIED
summary: Check figures against the source before use; agent-made ROI or payback numbers and creator dollar claims stay UNVERIFIED; check facts separately from design polish; fix poisoning by fact-checking live or asking.

name: Statistic scope hygiene
summary: Name what a chart measures (adoption is not quality), separate opinion from metric, and restrict a stat to its sample's population.

name: Adversarial primary-source verification with reliability labels
summary: Verifier agents re-check each claim and citation against the primary source and mark it confirmed, corrected or demoted; findings carry a reliability rating with the lenses that support and challenge them.

name: Evidence-tier honesty labels for learned methods
summary: Caption-only knowledge is never upgraded to observed; visual steps are UNKNOWN without a capture; log speech-vs-behavior gaps; filter hype; quarantine jailbreak/watermark/NSFW/cold-mail items; classify agent vs workflow by its loop, not its label.
jarvis_use: Required when Jarvis gains its own signal ingestion.

name: Render/screenshot visual verification before done
summary: Render the output and inspect it visually: per section at desktop and mobile, frame-by-frame scroll, full-size slides, PNG renders of diagrams, with two or more fix passes, a score threshold and a hard cap; match the check to the artifact type; skip the loop for animations; state which tool made the output.
jarvis_use: The computer and safari tools can do this now; make it a required step for UI and doc jobs.

name: Generated media QA checklist
summary: Check renders for product and text fidelity line by line, identity, hallucinated objects, color cast, first-frame clones, limb or orientation physics artifacts, frame bounds, claims vs release notes; a human watches it back before export.

name: UI break-it QA
summary: A headed adversarial pass: empty and invalid input, edit round-trips, keyboard submit, mobile width, a malformed-input matrix with duplicate-guard gaps, N unique scenarios as a stop, annotating one real break, plus a human click-through.

name: Negative and edge-case tests
summary: Ask what could go wrong and invoke the real entry point with that input; corrupt credentials and clear the session; decline then retry auth; clean-state end-to-end with leap-day and promo paths; a post-deploy fail-safe review (alerts, kill switch); reproduce a bug before reporting it.

name: Persona walkthrough panel
summary: Parallel persona reviewers (beginner, engineer, business owner, executive) click through the same artifact, and the results are aggregated.

name: Fail the build: named defects per dimension
summary: List concrete defects instead of 'looks good'; grade dimensions separately; 'flow completed' and 'values correct' are separate verdicts; check the DB to tell display bugs from storage bugs.

name: Adversarial critic pass on plans and drafts
summary: A read-only devil's-advocate critic (plan roaster, roast council ending go/reshape/kill, a 'be mean' second session, five-gate scope/evidence/attack/verify/report, debate on generated copy) counters sycophancy before acting.

name: Skeptic refuters, completeness critic and red-team ledger
summary: Skeptic agents try to refute each important claim, a completeness critic runs before phase-done, and attacks and rulings are logged with fixes applied and limits documented.

name: Multi-judge decision panel
summary: Criteria-scored judge personas, advocate/skeptic per finalist, fresh voters; persona debate rounds to a consensus; N-agent consensus as the stop for subjective work.

name: Present options and dissent unaveraged
summary: Give at least 2 paths with their tradeoffs; when views conflict, score each separately with its conditions and never blend a middle number; the human decides.

name: Secret/PII leak scan on writes and builds
summary: Review every edit for exposed keys and logged PII, scan client bundles for secret keys, check generated configs for plaintext keys, and keep key pages off recordings; report type and location only.

name: Enforce limits at the tool layer
summary: Prompts steer, tools enforce: detach tools that must not be used, block dangerous commands, inspect scripts before running them (indirect execution), plan-first with a permission ladder and no unattended bypass, read the plan, and show the raw script and wait for an explicit go; natural-language never-rules plus spend caps.
jarvis_use: send/pay/delete holds exist; hooks and script-content checks are missing.

name: Tiered code review by blast radius
summary: A fast local /review on everything; a multi-reviewer cloud review only before money, auth, migration or large-refactor merges, with spend approved by Evens.

name: Inbound/outbound guardrail checks
summary: Check text with pass/fail branches: keyword blocklist, jailbreak/injection score with a tuned threshold, NSFW, PII entities, topical scope, URL allowlist (HTTPS only, no userinfo), stacked and custom guards; sanitize on the way in, check on the way out; a pass is not permission to send.
jarvis_use: Score Safari and web text for injection before the operator loop acts on it.

name: Guard fixture suite
summary: Small labeled fixtures per guard, kept in a score table: a send request ends as a draft card, 'until satisfied' is refused at the cap, tape dollar figures are refused, a contradiction is not averaged, and a guard is tested against known misses (a plain password line); a DRY-RUN PASS keeps status WIRED.

name: Draft-only outbound with human review gate
summary: Outbound deliverables go to an internal review (email yourself a draft); a human fixes and sends; a green check never triggers a send.
jarvis_use: Safari holds send buttons for Evens's OK; add the no-send regression fixture.

name: Periodic self-audit of usage logs
summary: An /insights-style report over about 30 days of sessions (working, hindering, quick wins, skills to build), compared month over month; rank features by how much they change the real workday.

name: Memory and index audit
summary: Check routing pointers in both directions, index vs disk counts, feed freshness, duplication and contradictions, graded red/yellow/green; weekly self-review; hand-find a recent artifact by path; sample pages after bulk ingest; read stale memory first when behavior is odd; researcher/critic workspace audit.

name: Failure to written pattern and regression check
summary: Treat each slip as a case study; on a retrieval miss, replay the trace and say where it should have looked; write corrections into instructions, skills or memory; encode repeated corrections.
jarvis_use: Procedural memory today records finished jobs; add failed ones as patterns plus a regression check.

name: Skill improvement loop with binary checks
summary: Score a skill with binary pass/fail checks and iterate skill.md overnight, keeping only improvements; after a dry run, the agent proposes a patch to its own skill, applied only after verification.

name: Skill/agent misfire diagnosis
summary: Ask why X did not fire given this prompt by comparing the description to the prompt; validate the YAML front matter (closed quotes); merge overlapping skills; retest.

name: Cold-start context test
summary: In a fresh session or clean directory, ask what the business does, who works there and what to do next; a stranger-like answer means fix context or connectors before swapping models; checks skill discovery.

name: Ingest count and gold question
summary: After ingest, compare reported vs stored row count, then ask one known-answer question with a bare tool-only agent before building the next pipeline; one hit is a smoke test, not accuracy.

name: Connector preflight and generated-config audit
summary: Smoke-test each new connector or layer with a minimal read; confirm the connector is on and healthy before a long job; enumerate what resources it can actually see; open generated tool nodes for empty endpoints or descriptions; treat the setup guide as a debt list; judge integrations from first principles (auth, endpoints, payloads).

name: Pipeline output-count assertions
summary: Assert the expected branch gets one item and the others are empty; check Merge append vs combine item counts; run each entry path and diff.

name: Multi-hop end-to-end verification
summary: Verify at each hop: UI acknowledgement, backend execution, delivered artifact; commit, deploy, live number, source dedupe; keep the downstream systems visible side by side during a scenario run.

name: Prove idempotency by running twice
summary: Re-run a write workflow on the same inputs and count duplicates; query the destination by a stable unique key before create; split find from create; check prod env vars.

name: Check whether a side effect fired after an error
summary: An error after a tool call does not mean nothing happened; check the external system before any retry; curl the API directly to fact-check the wrapper.
jarvis_use: Avoid duplicate sends or writes on Jev escalation retries.

name: Verify claimed config or memory changes by diff
summary: After 'it learned' or 'fixed', open the stored prompt, config or node and diff it against the prior version before trusting the changelog.

name: Click-live the real production URL after ship
summary: Open and click through the live custom domain (preview is not prod), measure time-to-aha, run pay, login and core features as a user in test mode, and drive apps live in a browser or simulator rather than trusting tests.
jarvis_use: The safari tool can do this now; make it mandatory after a deploy job.

name: Served-HTML metadata and vendor-leak grep
summary: GET the page and assert lang, title, og and twitter tags; grep for builder-vendor strings.

name: Crawl an app into a screen/path map
summary: Generate a map of every screen and path of an app and reconcile it with the design, code and roadmap.

name: Landing-page acceptance checks
summary: Primary CTA visible at scrollY=0 and repeated after proof sections, in a color used nowhere else; reduced motion shows a static poster; one continuous plate; refs in visible copy.

name: Writing lints
summary: Strip AI giveaways (em dashes) and check that a draft sounds like the owner; thumbnail text of 4 words or fewer that passes the cover-the-title test.

name: Voice regression cases
summary: Test voice turns with background noise, dictated alphanumerics (plates, postcodes), sarcasm or frustration, multi-step function calls, and relative dates that force live lookups; use a transcript-view harness before live calls.

name: Known-answer vision checks
summary: Prove vision with a physical state change (fix the scissors) or a specific identification question with ground truth.

name: Structured output field hygiene
summary: Extracted fields use absolute full dates and explicit NA when missing, never relative words.

name: Long-horizon drift test and unattended-duration tracking
summary: Expect long-run agents to drift (Vending-Bench); test long runs with checkpoints; log wall-clock duration and intervention count per job.
jarvis_use: Pairs with the missing resume-after-reboot capability.

name: Decision-point replay and open-ended task bucket
summary: Freeze past work at decision points and compare the model's next step with the human's choice; score open-ended, no-spec tasks separately from routine ones.

name: Live reproduction as proof of learning (signal train loop)
summary: A method counts as learned only when the desk reproduces one demonstrated task with existing tools inside a cap and a separate verifier grades it (LEARNED, TESTING, GRADE, PROVEN); turn abstract claims into observable pass conditions.

name: Recap artifact and dated run summary
summary: End long jobs with one recap page that links every deliverable and how to run it (stranger test), plus a dated output file and run summary.

name: Check against an independent result or real outcome
summary: Compute the expected answer independently (a pivot) and compare, reading the generated query; validate predictions against the outcome once it resolves.

name: Retest capacity-blocked projects
summary: Keep a list of work abandoned on a model or rate-limit wall and re-run a small check when the model roster changes.

name: Cache hit rate as an SLO
summary: Track the cache-read share of input and alert on drops caused by prefix breaks (model switch, prompt edits, idle).

name: Promote or demote automation layers from run evidence
summary: Ship at the lowest layer that fits, then promote or demote based on run feedback; demote LLM steps that are actually deterministic.

name: Games as a stress-test bed for build loops
summary: Evaluate an autonomous build harness on a sandbox game whose features can grow without product bloat.

name: Sales call feedback analyzer
summary: Critique a rep's call transcript as a master salesperson for one-on-ones and role-play.

name: Two-week QA: internal week then client week
summary: Internal QA on sample and real data with edge-case stress tests, then a week of client real-world testing and iteration.

name: Caption-only signal packet ingest (yt-dlp json3 to full.txt + PACKET.md pointer)
summary: Pull YouTube captions with yt-dlp (en-orig json3, prefer official en when present), flatten them to an unchanged full.txt with a byte-identical transcripts/ mirror and the raw json3, and write PACKET.md with id, URL, title, channel, kind, duration, word count, upload and ingest dates, ICP note, load path and 'no invented summary'. Do not spawn desks at scrape time.
steps: yt-dlp --skip-download --write-subs --write-auto-subs --sub-langs en-orig,en --sub-format json3 (fall back to timedtext/transcript API)
Flatten to packets/<id>/full.txt and mirror byte-identical to transcripts/full.txt; keep the json3
Write PACKET.md: id, URL, title, channel, kind, duration, word count, upload and ingest dates, load path, 'not invented'
Add a steal vs operate-never table
Raw files are write-once; do not summarize in the packet
jarvis_use: The raw layer for every video Evens asks Jarvis to learn from. Jarvis has shell but no ingest job that writes packets to the repo.

name: Deep-video-learning LEARNED.md A-K template
summary: After reading the whole full.txt, fill fixed sections: A Source Map, B Atomic Knowledge, C Mental Models, D Procedures, E Examples, F Decision Rules (with refusals), G Contrarian, H Assumptions, I Questions, J Connections, K Future-Use, then Stolen machines and Operate-never. Includes recipe-style IF/THEN rules.
steps: Write atomic claims, procedures, IF/THEN rules, contrarian points, assumptions, questions
Link sibling signals and existing skills
End with stolen machines and operate-never
jarvis_use: The schema for distilled procedural-memory entries. Jarvis has procedural memory from finished jobs but no fixed extraction schema for signals.

name: Per-claim epistemic card (evidence status, modality, shown/clicked, failed/retried)
summary: Each atomic claim records Claim, Reasoning, Mechanism, Evidence quote, Conditions, Exceptions, Action, Confidence, Source@timestamp, Epistemic (SOURCE/INFERENCE/SYSTEM SYNTHESIS), knowledge type, modality, evidence status, shown/clicked/sequenced, failed/retried, and speech vs behaviour.
steps: Fill modality and evidence status; UNKNOWN when not observed
Record failures, retries and speech-vs-behaviour gaps
jarvis_use: Procedural memory entries should carry how Jarvis knows each step (said, shown or claimed).

name: Caption-honest provenance labels (visual/click/timestamp UNKNOWN)
summary: Treat a video as a trace of what was said, shown, clicked and sequenced. When only captions were read, mark visuals, clicks and timestamps UNKNOWN and evidence as transcript-implied. Never invent clicks, and require watch.json or frames before claiming something was shown. Separate transcript-proven claims from visual-only ones.
steps: Classify the packet as caption-only or watched
Upgrade to 'shown' only with frames or watch.json
jarvis_use: Required by the live-match rule: Jarvis must not claim a copied method matches its source on the strength of captions alone.

name: Goal-directed watch with stills paired to caption windows
summary: Pull ffmpeg stills at beats chosen from the transcript, from a local 720p source, each paired with a ±4s spoken window. Recut seeks that land on a talking head. If the default yt-dlp client returns 403, retry with the android client. Build a still/cue/spoken table that separates demonstrated pixels from declared speech, and save watch.json and segments.jsonl.
steps: Extract stills with ffmpeg at those timestamps
Pair each with a ±4s caption window; recut bad seeks
Write the still/cue/spoken table; mark clicks UNKNOWN
jarvis_use: The frames and contact-sheet half of signal ingestion, needed before any live-match claim.

name: Multi-source ground truth for an X clip
summary: For an X clip: take the tweet text from the fxtwitter API, find the source episode and pull its captions for the matching window, run Apple Speech ASR on the clip file, and map clip time to episode time. Pixels stay unobserved and ASR errors are kept as heard.
steps: Find the source YouTube episode and pull en-orig json3
Run local ASR on the clip file
Map clip clock to episode clock; label each text by source
jarvis_use: Jarvis's X ingestion path when Evens shares a clip.

name: Dedupe new methods into existing skills (MERGE file, parked skill names)
summary: Map each extracted method onto an existing skill. Write a MERGE-<date>.md saying why it is not a new skill. Park proposed skill names instead of writing a SKILL.md automatically. A new skill needs 2+ independent sources.
steps: Search the skills index for coverage
Park new names; never write SKILL.md automatically
jarvis_use: Needs skills library loading, which Jarvis lacks today.

name: Parallel research fan-out with claim voting and independent re-fetch verifiers
summary: Split the question into search angles and run parallel research agents across sources. Merge and dedupe the claims, run a per-claim adversarial vote, and have independent verifiers re-fetch every key quote, dropping any that fail. Then synthesize a cited report.
steps: Re-fetch each quote in a separate verifier pass
jarvis_use: Needs parallel read-only tools and sub-agents. The verifier pass doubles as the independent check before done.

name: Tape-to-practice dry run with tape stack remapped and a separate verifier
summary: Load the desk wiki, map the tape's vendors to Jarvis's own tools, write action lines (not quotes), rehearse in draft/local/preview mode only and stop at any send, pay or deploy step, then have Watchdog grade it. The builder never fills in the grade. Includes the DESIGN block and an action trace with UNKNOWN allowed, building original variants rather than clones.
steps: Map their tools to Jarvis tools
Hand the grade to a separate verifier
jarvis_use: Jarvis already holds send/pay/delete for OK. It lacks the independent verifier.

name: Tag on-tape and vendor numbers UNVERIFIED
summary: Every $, %, benchmark, count, price, survey figure, betting odd or leaked price from a source, including numbers an agent invented inside a demo, is listed under Assumptions as UNVERIFIED. ASR number errors are kept as spoken. Conflicting figures are recorded side by side, and confidence is split into 'method high, numbers unverified'.
steps: When figures conflict, keep both with source ids
Put 'quote as FACT' on the operate-never list
jarvis_use: Rule 28 is in Jarvis's live context, but no ingest step applies the tag automatically.

name: Speech-vs-behaviour, title-vs-body and failure ('scar') capture
summary: For each claim, record where the speaker's words, title or hook differ from what the demo did, and log the failures and retries seen on tape as the most reusable lessons. Store in-video misspeaks with their later correction, flag source incentives, and keep the failure paths as test cases.
steps: Compare against the shown procedure and outcomes
Record failed/retried events as regression cases
jarvis_use: Feeds the MATCH/PARTIAL/FAIL live-match check and Jarvis's own regression tests.

name: Do-not-flatten dissent rows and cross-signal links
summary: Link each signal to sibling ids (shorts vs long versions, retractions, competing methods). Keep conflicts as labelled dissent rows, never overwrite another desk's rows, record only what the new signal adds, and set separate confidence for 'he said it' vs 'it is true'.
steps: Search prior packets on the same topic
jarvis_use: Jarvis's procedural memory merges results today. It should keep conflicting sources side by side with their ids.

name: Steal vs operate-never split
summary: Each signal is split into what to steal (the pattern, mapped to existing skills) and an operate-never payload: vendor installs, spend, paid communities, sends, publishing, auto-complete, new ICP, quoting tape numbers as fact. Side-effect steps get a human approval inserted and require the artifact to be checked before done.
jarvis_use: Jarvis's Safari tool already holds send/pay/delete for OK. Learned methods don't yet carry their own never-do list.

name: Stolen-machine procedure card
summary: Compress each signal into one named machine: the workflow loop as an arrow chain, signal questions, objections, procedure, proving example, why it works, conditions, an operate-never payload, and the existing skills that run it.
steps: Attach the proving example and conditions
jarvis_use: Card format for Jarvis procedural-memory entries.

name: Shorts, trailers and fragments: score only the clip, link the long form
summary: For a short or trailer, note where it cuts off, extract only what the clip says, record the long-form id for a later pass, list open questions, never borrow numbers from sibling clips, and group a series of shorts under one parent method.
steps: Mark the result PARTIAL and list gaps
jarvis_use: Jarvis marks partial-source learning PARTIAL and names the full source to fetch.

name: Timestamp-cited atoms exported to jsonl
summary: Keep timed.txt and segments.json next to full.txt, cite each claim with a time range (or @UNKNOWN), and write atoms to knowledge/atoms/by-video/<id>.jsonl.
jarvis_use: Lets Jarvis jump straight to the cited moment when it verifies or pulls frames.

name: Local word-level timestamped transcript
summary: Transcribe a local video or YouTube URL with every word mapped to a timestamp, with a per-minute view and a per-word timing file.
steps: Run local ASR (one at a time, gated on disk and RAM)
Write word-timed JSON plus a readable view
jarvis_use: Fallback when captions are missing, and the basis for beat detection.

name: Four tape outputs and fixed write-flow order
summary: Split each tape into separate outputs: atoms and graph (knowledge), desk skill candidates (UNTESTED, never auto-installed), system-upgrade candidates, and capabilities/opportunities, plus a per-desk upgrade table. Fixed order: full.txt+PACKET, then A-K, then takes, then LEARNED, then atoms jsonl, then capability extraction, then patterns.
steps: Emit skill candidates mapped to desks
Log capabilities and opportunities as UNTESTED
jarvis_use: Keeps one signal from turning into one muddy summary.

name: Capability reconstruction card
summary: For something a tape made AI able to do, write GOAL, the ordered observed workflow, tools/triggers/state/guardrails, and a reproduce/generalize/improve decision with hard steps behind HITL. Status stays UNTESTED.
jarvis_use: Fill this in before Jarvis tries to copy a demonstrated capability.

name: TRAIN vs TRIAGE gate and autoresearch next-row pick
summary: Train on a signal only when full.txt exists and LEARNED has an action trace. Otherwise write a triage card (why it matters, capability guess, next action, duplicate?) with the coverage hole and stop. Self-improvement means proposing one TRAIN-eligible next row per sitting for the owner to validate, not running a daemon.
steps: Check for full.txt and an action trace
Propose the next row with a reason
jarvis_use: Stops Jarvis from copying methods from thin evidence.

name: Channel watcher: new video to structured brief
summary: A scheduled check on a named channel. On a new upload, pull the transcript and write key concepts, quotes and stats to a brief. With nothing new, stay quiet. One creator's videos are auto-summarized to a task tool.
steps: Check the channel no more than every 15 minutes, using the existing scheduler
On a new id, run packet ingest
Write the brief to the internal inbox

summary: Pick a named shape per task: solo loop (default), maker-checker, manager+helpers, classify-and-act, fan-out-and-synthesize, adversarial review, generate-and-filter, tournament, loop-until-done; any multi-model plan names the assignee per subtask and the combiner.
jarvis_use: Jarvis defaults to solo and adds a checker for high-stakes output; fan-out plans name assignee and combiner.
steps: Add checker when grading is unreliable

name: Sub-agents vs agent teams
summary: Sub-agents report only to the main session and cannot talk to each other; teams can debate to consensus but cost much more.
jarvis_use: Hub-and-spoke by default; debate only when a decision needs it.

name: Harness above agents (workflow engine decides when the LLM runs)
summary: A workflow engine (YAML/code, e.g. Archon) owns orchestration and invokes the LLM only at marked steps; subagents exchange markdown contracts; an observability board tracks runs; exposed as CLI plus a skill.
jarvis_use: Encode repeatable Jarvis jobs as scripted pipelines with LLM calls only at judgment steps, logged per run.

name: Deploy chooser: live operator vs scheduled script
summary: Place each job on where it runs (machine vs cloud) and how deterministic (agent loop vs script); check which WAT parts it carries and whether machine/session must stay on. Self-healing exists only in live agent sessions; deployed scripts log failures for a supervised repair.
jarvis_use: Before any recurring job, Jarvis fills where/determinism/WAT/machine-on/session-on and picks the lightest host.
steps: Route failures to a supervised session

name: Async submit then poll
summary: Create returns a ticket/task ID; wait an initial interval, GET status by ID, dedupe/limit the response, loop on a short interval tuned to real latency until terminal state, then fetch the artifact; add a max-attempt cap.
jarvis_use: Standard poller for renders, builds, ASR and agent runs in Jarvis background jobs.

name: Gather, then per-item act (fan-out/fan-in)
summary: A finder task gathers items and triggers one writer run per item so a failed write retries alone; Split Out to per-item processing and Aggregate back to one item before the final step.
jarvis_use: Jarvis jobs gather then act per item with per-item logging and retry, combining before the final output.

name: Off-window tool output
summary: Route large payloads through a CLI that stores/mirrors raw results locally and returns only a short formatted summary to the agent context.
jarvis_use: Jarvis tool wrappers write raw responses to disk and return summaries; complements lean screenshot context.

name: Brittle capabilities as typed standalone tools (paths not bytes)
summary: Wrap capabilities (image gen, edits, posting) as separate subflows/scripts with declared inputs, reusable by any agent; pass only small variables (IDs, prompts), and let the subflow handle binary I/O.
jarvis_use: Heavy media/file tools return file paths or IDs, never raw bytes, through the Jarvis loop.

name: Schema-validated structured outputs
summary: When model output feeds later steps, require a JSON schema (structured output parser / vendor structured outputs) instead of a prose blob; downstream maps separate fields.
jarvis_use: Every Jarvis model step that feeds a tool gets a schema; reject or retry on a miss.

name: MCP discover, read schema, call, verify
summary: Client searches workflows/tools, reads required fields, executes with payload, then verifies the side effect in the target system.
jarvis_use: Jarvis's MCP use follows discover-schema-call-verify; sends stay behind approval.

name: Webhook event as pointer: wait, re-fetch, fail closed
summary: Webhook bodies often carry only an ID; wait briefly, fetch the authoritative record by ID, check required fields exist before writing, clean the payload.
jarvis_use: For any event-fed ingest, Jarvis re-fetches by ID and fails closed on missing fields before writing memory.

name: No user files to third-party hosts without OK
summary: Only use approved tools for company/customer data; flag steps that publish files to public hosts (e.g. ImageBB hop) and prefer signed/temporary URLs; managed indexes store data off-box, don't dedupe, so keep an upload ledger and never upload PII.
jarvis_use: Data-classification allowlist checked before any file/text leaves the Mac; public-host uploads need Evens's OK.

name: Harness-agnostic project directory (the folder is the OS)
summary: Keep instructions, skills, scripts and projects as plain files in one directory any harness (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw) can operate; portability test: could you switch vendor in about an hour.
jarvis_use: Jarvis procedures, memory and routing live in repo files, not vendor config, so models/harnesses swap without rebuild.

name: Vendor-outage fallback drill
summary: Ask whether you could keep working if your main agent/model went down; wire a second harness/model into the same directory and base the stack on what doesn't change.
jarvis_use: Jev holds a tested fallback per core loop; drill a provider outage.

name: Four Cs in order: context, connections, capabilities, cadence
summary: Build an AI OS in stacked layers; each depends on the one before; don't schedule (cadence) what isn't proven in context, connections and capabilities. First two = second brain.
jarvis_use: Readiness checklist: refuse to schedule a job whose lower layers aren't proven; score Jarvis on each C.

name: Operator habits from a leaked system prompt
summary: Recalled knowledge isn't current, so verify; a prompt implying a file exists doesn't mean it does; attempt an ambiguous ask first then ask at most one question; own errors and stay on the problem.
jarvis_use: Stat files before claiming them, re-check memory facts with tools, attempt-then-one-question on vague voice asks.

name: Inject current date/time and time zone
summary: Without a clock the agent offered slots from a stale date; add now plus TZ to the prompt and re-test.
jarvis_use: Inject current ET date/time each turn; check dates first when scheduling looks wrong.

name: Reject or split asks against mission
summary: On triage, compare each spec against mission goals and non-goals; reject out-of-scope with a reason, split oversized, or ask to pair.
jarvis_use: Jarvis checks asks against scope and locks and pushes back with a reason or proposes a split.

name: Global rules vs stricter unattended-mode rules + mission.md
summary: Global rules always load; factory rules (bite-size, one task at a time, no auto-commit/PR, named deploy) load only in autonomous runs; mission.md holds goals and explicit out-of-scope.
jarvis_use: Layer a stricter rule file on Jarvis for unattended jobs, plus a mission file with non-goals.
steps: Factory rules file for autonomous runs
Load factory rules only in factory mode

name: Agent-to-agent delegation with view-only audit thread
summary: Inter-agent conversations are visible to the human read-only, and the delegate notes in its own thread that it was asked, so nothing happens in secret.
jarvis_use: Log every Jarvis sub-agent handoff as a transcript file and show a 'delegated to X' receipt.

name: Headless claude -p behind a UI
summary: Dashboard buttons run Claude headlessly (claude -p with a skill prompt) in the background and show results.
jarvis_use: A possible sub-agent path: Jarvis background jobs as headless processes with scoped prompts.

name: Agent loop calls deterministic tools (one brain front, dumb tools back)
summary: Reach for the AI loop first but call deterministic code/workflows as tools; keep reasoning in the front agent and make backend tools single-purpose with no nested LLM; the agent orchestrates data platforms via MCP instead of their UIs.
jarvis_use: Jarvis's single loop already calls shell/MCP tools; keep backend tools LLM-free.

name: Agent node spec card
summary: An agent is defined by name, instructions, chat-history toggle, model, reasoning level, tools and output format.
jarvis_use: Minimum spec card for any Jarvis sub-agent or routed model call.

name: AI systems pyramid
summary: Rank by autonomy: chatbot/skill, deterministic workflow, AI workflow, agent; risk and cost rise each level, so pick the lowest that works.
jarvis_use: Tag each Jarvis capability with its level; higher levels need more gates.

name: AIOS five layers
summary: Context, data, intelligence, automate, build, in order.
jarvis_use: Check context and data exist before automating or building.

name: Explicit item-count and collision rules
summary: State a burst rule (keep last, dedupe by ID, queue) instead of silently processing duplicates; prefer linear single-item flows and assert one item before any send (parallel branches once produced three emails).
jarvis_use: Jarvis pipelines stay single-path and assert count before output/notify.
steps: Merge to one item before send

name: Normalize every inbound channel into one envelope
summary: Switch on input type (photo/text/form/trigger), persist attachments first, and map all paths into one standard field/object so downstream logic has one contract.
jarvis_use: Voice, text, screenshot and file inputs become one request object with file paths before the loop.

name: Bind routing IDs from the trigger, not the model
summary: Model fills creative fields; chat/session IDs come by expression from the trigger node.
jarvis_use: Session, reply channel and file IDs bound deterministically.

name: Serialize model text into JSON bodies
summary: Newlines and double quotes in agent output break JSON request bodies; escape or serialize instead of string templating.
jarvis_use: Build payloads with a JSON serializer in shell/Python.

name: Wire APIs from the vendor's official curl and docs
summary: Import the docs' curl into the request, then go field by field: required or optional, options, desired value; delete unused optional fields; variables before '?' go in the path, after go in query/auth.
jarvis_use: Jarvis converts the official curl mechanically and annotates fields against docs before changing values.

name: Pin model and params in the request
summary: Playground model choices don't persist to API calls and wrappers may lack new params (e.g. thinking level); set model and params explicitly and make a direct API call when a wrapper lacks them.
jarvis_use: Jarvis pins model/params in config and checks docs when behavior is off.
steps: Direct call if wrapper lacks it

name: Model-filled tool parameters, inspected per call
summary: Make the request body a $fromAI expression so the agent writes the query and may split a compound question into several calls; inspect each call's input when debugging.
jarvis_use: Retrieval as a parameterized tool; inspect traces.

name: Narrow context by key before the model
summary: Look up rows by a key (sender email) or filtered query tools before the model, instead of passing whole tables; avoids token cost and hallucination.
jarvis_use: Deterministic lookup first, then model.

name: Compute numbers and dates in code
summary: Arithmetic, valuation, booking clock, TZ and notice period computed deterministically (calculator/code); the model only words the result.
jarvis_use: Jarvis computes in Python/shell and explains.

name: Templated prompts filled per run
summary: One prompt with {{variables}} filled per call; source documents fetched each run and injected; lists formatted programmatically with separators; the user message is constructed explicitly when there's no chat trigger.
jarvis_use: Jarvis prompts built from templates and re-read file references.

name: Prompts and models as keyed config
summary: Keep per-workflow model, system and user prompt in a keyed table/config looked up at runtime; use enums over free-typed slugs; private prompts stay out of shared exports; re-test instruction obedience after a model swap.
jarvis_use: Per-task prompts and model tiers in one config Jev reads.

name: Run parameters in one config block
summary: A config node/file right after the trigger holds recipients, topics, style, query; tools stay single-purpose; secrets live only in credentials/env.
jarvis_use: Per-run parameters in config files so tools stay reusable.

name: Wireframe the flow before building
summary: Sketch trigger, steps, AI steps (colored), branches and dependencies on a whiteboard, then build from the diagram and derive tool list and prompt sections.
jarvis_use: Jarvis drafts an if-X-do-Y map (Mermaid/VectorCraft) before multi-step builds.

name: Update on a unique key
summary: Update operations match on email/phone/ID, never name; make sure every later trigger carries the key.
jarvis_use: Key every ledger/memory update on a stable unique ID; refuse when not unique.

name: One folder per job, scratch apart
summary: Start every deliverable in a dedicated project folder; intermediates and ad-hoc scripts go to temp/; only reusable tools promote to tools/.
jarvis_use: Jarvis writes job outputs to one job folder and scratch to a session scratch dir.

name: Smallest fix first (collapse the workflow, check native tools)
summary: Ask what workflow the data serves and whether the step can be removed; check existing platforms/CRM native features; prefer the simplest stack before building.
jarvis_use: Before new code, Jarvis checks installed tools, skills and MCPs for a native fit.

name: Named reusable credential instead of inline keys
summary: Store a key once as a named credential (predefined, header Bearer, or query auth) and reuse it; turn off duplicated inline headers.
jarvis_use: Reference env var names only; never inline keys in scripts or configs.

name: Scoped, capped key per agent
summary: Create a separate key per agent/harness, named for purpose, with spend caps and endpoint restrictions; don't reuse another project's key.
jarvis_use: Jarvis asks Evens to create least-privilege keys per capability.

name: Token-scope errors and duplicate env names
summary: When a token lacks a permission, name the missing scope, rotate to a correctly scoped token, and delete the old entry so duplicate var names don't clash.
jarvis_use: Name missing scope, ask Evens to rotate, check for duplicate var names.

name: Host vs container filesystem check
summary: Confirm whether the process reads config from the host or inside a container before editing.
jarvis_use: Check which filesystem a process reads before editing config.

name: Runtime inventory
summary: A manager project with one folder per agent server (host, container vs root, integrations, env location) used to debug, reboot and ask for help.
jarvis_use: Inventory doc of runtimes Jarvis touches, env var names only.

name: Read-only security posture audit
summary: Have the agent survey the environment and propose firewall rules; schedule periodic audit reports (source also mentions attack tests, out of scope).
jarvis_use: Read-only report of open ports/listeners on the Mac; no offensive testing.

name: When to split into a new agent
summary: Start with one agent; split only for different credentials/tools, separate long-term memory, or separate ongoing audience/schedule; migrate markdown skills when splitting.
jarvis_use: Jarvis stays single-loop; split only when blast radius differs.

name: Occupy/release lock on scarce resources
summary: Fetch an available resource, mark it unavailable during use, mark it available after (phone numbers for outbound calls).
jarvis_use: Locks for browser tab, live surface or device once Jarvis runs parallel work.

name: Throttle bulk actions
summary: Unthrottled bulk email melted on-prem servers; rate-limit any bulk operation and don't assume an abstraction does it.
jarvis_use: Rate-limit bulk shell/network loops.

name: Separate logging pipe (session-end event only)
summary: Point the assistant's server URL at a webhook and enable only the end-of-call report, keeping logging apart from action tools.
jarvis_use: Logging as its own pipe subscribed to job-end.

name: Separate memory write and read paths
summary: Build RAG ingest and query as two pipelines; validate ingest with a gold question before building query.
jarvis_use: Memory writes and reads testable separately.

name: Prune by known constraints before choosing
summary: Turing's Bombe used guessed fragments to eliminate contradicting settings in bulk, leaving a short list for humans.
jarvis_use: Prune candidates with known constraints before asking a model or Evens.

name: Expert-system failure mode
summary: Hand rules work for narrow stable jobs but grow fragile: conflicts and maintenance load signal a switch to learned/model handling.
jarvis_use: Consistent with Jarvis's no-phrase-routes rule.

name: Account-adjacent actions = confirm first
summary: Saved logins, always-allow send, execute-any workflows and live calendar writes are treated like money transfers: human before the write.
jarvis_use: Safari login walls go to Evens; send/pay/delete held for OK.

name: Router file imported by every harness
summary: Keep AGENTS.md identical to CLAUDE.md or import it with @AGENTS.md so one source drives all harnesses; point others to memory.md.
jarvis_use: Jarvis re-reads AGENT_RULES/JARVIS_CONTEXT each turn from one source.

name: Global vs project scope for rules, skills and agents
summary: User-level ~/.claude holds cross-project preferences; repo .claude/ holds project-shared ones; move files between scopes as needed.
jarvis_use: Global operator rules vs per-project packs; no secrets in shared scope.

name: One git-backed root with nested projects
summary: One OS root pushed to GitHub, nested CLAUDE.md per subproject, frequently used projects in an other-worlds folder so one push/pull syncs machines.
jarvis_use: Index sibling projects under one root; respect isolation of shared repos.

name: Internal facts vs deliverable repo
summary: Client facts live in the OS; deliverables are a separate repo the OS references by path.
jarvis_use: Job facts in memory, deliverables referenced by path.

name: System-upgrade registry with dedupe
summary: Harness lessons tracked as rows UNTESTED -> WIRED (skill+funnel+hook) -> DRY-RUN PASS; duplicates map to one canonical ID; WIRED is not accepted.
jarvis_use: Single registry of Jarvis harness upgrades; dedupe before adding.

name: Build the factory first / primitives registry
summary: Build reusable primitives (login, payments, share) before a single product; registry status stub/wired_untested/connected, connected only after verifier grade; payments stay stub until owner says.
jarvis_use: When a task type repeats, extract reusable procedures before one-offs.

name: Thin adapter over existing code; don't fake gaps
summary: Wrap existing auth with a thin adapter exposing the primitive interface, keep UI unchanged, record missing handlers instead of inventing them.
jarvis_use: Adapt via thin wrappers and report missing pieces.

name: Graph engineering / per-step micro-loops
summary: Wire several AIs as a team graph; give each step its own trigger/check/log loop; the speaker calls it usually overkill; one source is a truncated post.
jarvis_use: Add per-step checks only where a step fails often; fan-out only after Jev preflight.

name: Shared connectors, isolated per-lane computers
summary: Connectors and skills are shared across agents once connected; each agent keeps its own computer/browser session with persisted logins.
jarvis_use: MCP connectors global; isolate browser profiles per task lane to limit blast radius.

name: Agent / environment / session / vault split
summary: Hosted agent split into definition, environment (container with networking rules), session, and credential vault; each agent gets its own environment.
jarvis_use: Keep the same split for Jarvis jobs; sandbox network not unrestricted by default.

name: Egress allowlist tiers
summary: Cloud environments offer trusted (default), custom domains, full, none; full raises prompt-injection exfiltration risk, so prefer custom with named domains.
jarvis_use: Unattended Jarvis egress defaults to an allowlist; widening needs a named domain and Evens's OK.

name: Hosted runner for always-on jobs
summary: Write automations as code tasks locally and host them on a runner (Trigger.dev) with schedules, retries and queues so they run with the laptop off.
jarvis_use: Raise hosting as an explicit approval question instead of assuming the Mac stays awake.

name: Secrets in host env, var named in the prompt
summary: Remote runs don't get a gitignored .env; bulk-import env vars into the host for dev and prod, and tell the prompt to use the env var rather than hunt for .env.
jarvis_use: Only relevant if Jarvis jobs move to hosted runners; first check host env on auth errors.

name: Git-push deploy behind approval
summary: Agent inits git, creates private repo, pushes with .env excluded; host (Vercel/Trigger.dev) auto-deploys on tracking-branch push; rule: test local first, push only when told.
jarvis_use: Jarvis preps branch/PR; deploy-triggering push is Tier-3 for Evens.

name: Dark-factory autonomy levels
summary: Levels from autocomplete to spec-only; level 3 (agent writes, human plans and validates) recommended until the harness (queue, separate reviewer, hold-outs, deploy) is proven.
jarvis_use: Jarvis operates at level 3; autonomy rises only with a proven validation harness.

name: Merge is not ship (blue-green)
summary: If merged PRs never reach users you built a PR generator; deploy to standby then flip traffic.
jarvis_use: Label merged, standby and live separately; the flip is Evens's step.

name: Dumb front end, webhook back end with field contract
summary: Build the capture UI in a builder, POST to a webhook on button click with an explicit list of fields; all logic in the workflow; nothing is stored until wired.
jarvis_use: If Jarvis builds a capture page, keep it dumb and prove one POST lands with expected fields.

name: Respond-to-webhook for inline results
summary: Set the webhook to respond via a Respond node so the front end waits and renders the result instead of emailing it (named, not built).
jarvis_use: Return results to the caller when they should see them inline.

name: Native provider tools via Responses API
summary: Enabling the Responses API on the chat model node unlocks built-in web search, file search and code interpreter without separate tool nodes.
jarvis_use: Before adding a search tool, check whether the Jev-routed provider offers native tools.

name: Persistent voice socket owned by one service
summary: Leaving the playground needs function definitions in code and a persistent server process holding the Live API websocket.
jarvis_use: Jarvis voice path: one long-lived socket owned by one service; live :4018 unchanged without Evens.

name: File signal bus between voice and face
summary: Voice writes status notes to a bus directory; face reads it; hands optional; default permission ask.
jarvis_use: Possible decoupling for voice and Face/Orb; live surface change needs Evens's OK.

name: Gemini File Search managed RAG via four HTTP calls
summary: Create store, resumable upload to /files, import into store (store name in path), generateContent with store as the agent's knowledge tool.
jarvis_use: Only with Evens's approval; default stays owned RAG and no PII upload.

name: Supervisor agent keeps workers working
summary: A central orchestrator whose only job is keeping N worker agents running (claims unverified).
jarvis_use: Pattern maps to Watchdog, not a new daemon.

name: A2A protocol for agent-to-agent coordination
summary: MCP connects agents to tools; A2A connects agents to agents with agent cards, a task lifecycle and secure context sharing.
jarvis_use: Only if Jarvis must coordinate with fleet agents: capability card plus defined task lifecycle.

name: Design AI into team workflows, not raw credits
summary: Handing out raw model credits is unsafe; map team workflows and design where AI plugs in with safe environments.
jarvis_use: Jarvis wires capabilities into named jobs with guards rather than raw tool access.

name: Plan, ask questions, approve, then execute
summary: Plan mode first; agent asks clarifying questions, turns a vague idea into a PRD/plan, and the plan is reviewed/approved before any side-effecting execution.
evidence: shown in many tapes; Jarvis has ask_owner and approval holds but no enforced plan step
jarvis_use: Plan card plus owner approval before side effects.

name: Options with a recommended default and explanation
summary: Present choices as multiple choice with a recommended default and a one-line explanation of each option, instead of auto-picking Recommended.
jarvis_use: ask_owner prompts formatted as options with a default.

name: Unknowns check: what am I not thinking of
summary: End planning by asking the model what has been overlooked; the plan includes a things-you-haven't-considered section.
steps: Fold the risks into the plan
jarvis_use: Standard closing line of Jarvis plan step.

name: Editable plan: annotate and override before accept
summary: Comment on parts of the plan or override bad choices (tool, vendor), keep planning, then accept.
jarvis_use: Evens's edits to the plan are binding before execution.

name: Research pass before planning
summary: When unsure whether or how something is possible, have the agent research options (or run deep research) before planning.
jarvis_use: Bounded web_search/fetch pass before unfamiliar builds.

name: Local resource guide from official docs
summary: Load API/SDK docs into the project, have the agent write a reference .md, and point the build prompt (CLAUDE.md) to it so code follows the current API.
jarvis_use: Per-platform reference doc stored in procedural memory.

name: Code beats clicks: configure vendors via API from docs
summary: Let the coding agent read vendor docs and configure through the API instead of clicking the dashboard, then check the result in the UI once.
jarvis_use: Prefer API/MCP over Safari clicking when an API exists.

name: Fewest hops between systems
summary: Prefer direct vendor-to-vendor integration over an extra orchestrator hop unless the hop adds something needed.
steps: Pick the shortest that meets needs
jarvis_use: Architecture preference in Jarvis plans.

name: Outcome brief: goal, guardrails, exit criteria
summary: Brief like you would a human developer: source, action, destination, what done looks like, guardrails; ask for delegation and verification; give slightly-too-hard tasks without micromanaging.
jarvis_use: Job-card format for every delegated or long job.

name: State the why and the stakes, with a verify clause
summary: Tell the agent why the work matters and what a bad result would cost, plus an explicit post-build verification step.
jarvis_use: One-line why on every job card passed into the prompt.

name: Precise systems vocabulary in prompts
summary: Replace vague asks with trigger/object/transform/endpoint specs, specific metrics, and pre-listed failure modes (rate limits, malformed JSON, token expiry).
steps: Ask what decision the output serves
jarvis_use: Jarvis rewrites vague asks into precise specs.

name: Mirror vs diverge from a reference
summary: For reference-driven builds, state which aspects to copy (structure, copy) and which must differ (design).
jarvis_use: Prompt pattern for reference builds.

name: Real sample payload plus output contract
summary: Paste the exact incoming JSON, state the exact output format and failure sentinels, run on real data, and loop on the observed diff.
steps: Feed back what it did and why it is wrong
jarvis_use: Transform steps written from real samples, not guessed schemas.

name: Goal loop with a checkable stop condition
summary: /goal-style runs that keep working until an objective, countable condition holds (files exist, counts, timing, tests), started from a spoken or written goal.
jarvis_use: Script-checkable terminal condition on long jobs.

name: Independent evaluator decides done
summary: A separate evaluator model or session judges done (hidden hold-outs, grade from another session) so the worker cannot declare itself finished.
steps: Separate model/session checks against stop condition
jarvis_use: Verifier gate before Jarvis's done tool.

name: Bounded retry loop with explicit done signal
summary: Loop work back to the agent until success, with a max-iteration cap and explicit done marker; after repeated failed fixes, stop and redesign.
jarvis_use: Extends the repetition brake with a success check and cap.

name: Job card in a file, pointer in the prompt
summary: Put the full instruction set (mission, guardrails, phases, done) in a file below a divider and pass only a short pointer prompt.
steps: Prompt: read file, execute below divider, report only when done
jarvis_use: Auditable job card file per long job.

name: Clear or compact context at about 60%
summary: Watch the context meter and compact or clear once usage passes roughly 60%, and between phases (setup to build), relying on files for continuity.
jarvis_use: Jarvis already keeps last 3 screenshots; add a context threshold.

name: Structured handoff into a fresh session
summary: Write a handoff (done, open questions, decisions locked, key files, pick-up point), clear, and reload it in a fresh session or another agent.
jarvis_use: Basis for resume after reboot; job state persisted every turn.

name: Rewind instead of stacking corrections
summary: Roll code and conversation back to a checkpoint (/rewind) or branch to try alternatives rather than piling on corrections.
jarvis_use: Drop failed branches from working context.

name: Session-start context dump
summary: Start each working session by loading goals, constraints and current state before any task work.
jarvis_use: Load CURRENT_STATE and job context at turn start.

name: Plan / build / check as separate passes with file handoffs
summary: Director loop and PIV: plan with context, delegate build, verify independently, improve the way of working; separate sessions per phase pass artifacts (plan doc, execution report).
jarvis_use: Large jobs split into passes; checker never the builder.

name: Plan.md: goal, success, validation, touch-points
summary: One markdown spec per task (or PRP context pack): goal, what success looks like, how it is validated, which files or systems change.
jarvis_use: 4-section plan.md before multi-file work.

name: Read-only sub-agents for bulk reading and research
summary: Offload independent, reading-heavy or noisy work to sub-agents with fresh context and cheaper models; only summaries return; dependent steps stay in the main loop.
steps: Is it an independent pile you won't reread?
Spawn named read-only worker on cheap tier
jarvis_use: delegate tool, max 3 streams, Jev picks tier.

name: Fresh sub-agent per task plus scope-drop gate
summary: GSD shape: each task runs in a fresh sub-agent with only needed context; gates catch a planner that silently drops requirements and check security against a threat model.
jarvis_use: Final output checked against the original requirement list.

name: Map-reduce fan-out: cheap workers, one strong merger

steps: Worker per partition with verbatim instructions

name: Worker brief: goal, role, output, recipient, owned files

jarvis_use: Template every delegate call uses.

name: Size fan-out to provider rate limits
summary: Check tokens-per-minute limits before designing parallel sub-agent fan-out.
jarvis_use: Jev checks provider limits before parallel calls.

name: Sub-agent spec as a markdown file
summary: Define workers as .md files with front matter (name, description trigger, tools, model, memory, color), created via the /agents wizard and trimmed to sharp triggers.
jarvis_use: Versioned worker specs alongside the missing skills library.

name: Decision rule: skill vs sub-agent vs team
summary: Skill runs inline; sub-agent for fresh context/parallel/other model; team only when specialists must run concurrently and message each other. Skills and sub-agents can nest.

name: Explicit naming beats auto-routing
summary: Name the skill, agent or file explicitly (/ and @, exact trigger phrase); some harnesses (Codex sub-agents) never auto-invoke.
steps: Name the target explicitly in dispatch
jarvis_use: Explicit names win over fuzzy matching.
